blocks.text: Requirements: lot-code pick on dairy and chemicals

This is the working cut for PCF-REQ-2024-121 on October 24, 2024. Lila Voss asked for a written bound after the current path (Lot tribal, some people write it, most do not) stopped being honest. I am Jeilen Jones, Order Picker, writing for Marcus Hale, Tasha Quinn, and Ben Crowe. Primary host wms.pinecrest.internal. If you are skimming, jump the decision callout, then the refuse on paper lot log at pack, then open questions. If you are on the floor next shift, jump the constraints, the numbers table, and the steps.

FEFO. Scan lot on dairy and chemicals. WMS blocks confirm without lot. Reject a paper log at pack. I am not restating a hallway yes. paper lot log at pack is out because Pack paper is after the fact. A recall needs the pick scan. October 3 paper missed 9 lots. Cost of doing nothing is already in the numbers: missed=9, families=2, weeks=5, fefo=1, block=1, paper=0, dairy=1, chem=1. Sibling tickets PCF-2288 and PCF-MTG-2024-029. I will not reopen paper lot log at pack in a side thread because someone asked for a rate waiver. Tasha Quinn is the acceptor unless the owners line says otherwise.

blocks.text: Background. Why the current path is the wrong tool

Ben Crowe owns a leftover that is easy to skip: rf.pinecrest.internal. I will ping once. After that the owner is late, not blocked. Unique to this file (23): refuse on paper lot log at pack, lock is FEFO, RF lot scan, WMS block, no pack paper as control. I will not hide a process change inside a 'quick align' on PCF-2288.
If dairy leaves without a lot scan, we cannot recall it. That is the whole job.

What a skeptical lead would try first on wms.pinecrest.internal: the path Lila Voss actually has, not an empty-tote photo. Metric I will argue is a clean confirm, not a vanity units-per-hour. If we cannot show that path on cooler.pinecrest.internal with the numbers already in this file, we do not have a cut. Jeilen Jones will not accept a hallway yes as that proof.
